steps: eval (window.__ff=(secs)=>{ const W=__G.war; for(let i=0;i<secs*10;i++){ W.update(0.1, __G.PL, false); __G.fx.update(0.1);} const n=[0,0,0]; for(const I of __G.ISLANDS) n[I.owner]++; const u={}; for(const x of W.units) u[x.type+(x.side)]=(u[x.type+(x.side)]||0)+1; return {t:Math.round(W.time), isl:n, units:u, emat:Math.round(W.E.mat), bship:Math.round(W.E.bship), carrier:Math.round(W.carrier.hp), kraken:Math.round(W.enemyCarrier.hp), over:W.over, proj:W.proj.length, heli:__G.Z.alive, lives:__G.G.lives}; }, 1)
